Each of these compounds appears to interact with the dual serine/threonine and tyrosine protein kinase, which in turn targets SNU1. The varying scores across the paths indicate a degree of confidence in the relationships, though the exact mechanism of interaction remains unclear. The presence of multiple distinct compounds acting on the same target suggests a potential role for these compounds in modulating the kinase activity that ultimately affects SNU1. The integration of these findings highlights a possible pathway where Npc115753 may influence SNU1 through a series of kinase-mediated interactions, though further investigation is needed to clarify the precise nature of these relationships.
